ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, points K, L, and N form triangle KLN, and side KL and side LN each have an identical pink tick mark, indicating KL = LN. Angle KLN, that is, the angle formed at point L by LK and LN, is labeled 18° in the figure. The figure also shows equilateral tick marks for triangle LMN and some 25° and 20° labels, but according to the given method, finding ∠LKN only needs the information of triangle KLN. Then reason: In triangle KLN, KL = LN, so the base is KN, and the base angles ∠LKN and ∠KNL are equal. Let ∠LKN = ∠KNL = x. The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, therefore x + x + 18° = 180°, giving 2x = 162°, so x = 81°. Therefore ∠LKN = 81°.

raw_record.question_text: $\triangle KLN$ and $\triangle LMN$ are isosceles and $m\angle JKN = 130$. Find the measure of $\angle LKN$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: in triangle KLN, the tick marks show KL = LN, and the marked angle at L between LK and LN is 18°. The text states triangle KLN is isosceles and asks for angle LKN. Since KL = LN, the base is KN, so the base angles at K and N are equal. Use the triangle angle sum: let angle LKN = angle KNL = x. Then x + x + 18 = 180, so x = 81.

method.method_draft: Read the full figure: KL = LN in triangle KLN, LM = MN in triangle LMN, angle KLN is 18°, and angle NLM is 20°. Let x = m∠LKN. Because KL = LN, angle KNL is also x. In triangle LMN, since LM = MN and the base angle at L is 20°, the base angle at N is also 20°, so angle LMN = 140°. Now use quadrilateral K-N-M-L: its angles are x at K, x + 20 at N, 140 at M, and 18 + 20 = 38 at L. Their sum is 360°, so x + (x + 20) + 140 + 38 = 360, giving 2x = 162 and x = 81.

再推理：设 x = m∠LKN。因为 △KLN 中 KL = LN，所以底角相等，m∠KNL = x。因为 △LMN 中 LM = MN，且图中给出 m∠NLM = 20°，所以另一个底角 m∠LNM = 20°，从而 m∠LMN = 180° - 20° - 20° = 140°。考虑四边形 K-N-M-L：在 K 点的内角是 x；在 N 点的内角是 ∠KNL + ∠LNM = x + 20°；在 M 点的内角是 140°；在 L 点的内角是 ∠KLN + ∠NLM = 18° + 20° = 38°。四边形内角和为 360°，所以 x + (x + 20) + 140 + 38 = 360。化简得 2x + 198 = 360，2x = 162，x = 81。因此 m∠LKN = 81°。
